title: Seacrest Beach "Lucky Sevens" 77 Endless Summer Way W
h1: Seacrest Beach "Lucky Sevens" 77 Endless Summer Way W
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short bike ride to the beach and Rosemary- Access to Seacrest’s 12,000 square foot community pool- Complimentary tram service to the beach- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Escape to Lucky Sevens, a charming Seacrest Beach home with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms that sleeps 15 guests. Nestled a short bike ride from the Gulf and the delights of Rosemary Beach, this 2-story home is a convenient base for exploring all of Scenic 30A. Imagine lackadaisical days floating in the enormous community pool or chilling on the beach—easily accessible with Seacrest tram service!Cheerful aqua siding and a roomy front porch welcome guests to this beautiful beach abode. Sit back on the wicker chairs and enjoy a slow-paced afternoon watching the palm trees sway. Inside, discover a connected living, dining, and kitchen space with a shiplap accent wall, golden-hued hardwood floors, and a seashell chandelier bringing hints of the beach indoors. In the living space, an oversized sectional offers plenty of room for the group to relax around the Smart TV. Steps away, the dining table for 8 awaits lively morning chats over pancakes and coffee. The kitchen is well-equipped with high-end appliances, tons of storage, and a 3-stool breakfast bar—perfect for keeping an eye on little ones while cooking. To the side, an exterior glass door lets in sunlight and leads to the outdoor shower and propane grill. This level hosts 1 guest bedroom with a soft king bed. For convenience, all the home’s bedrooms feature an attached private bathroom and Smart TV.Upstairs features 2 lovely guest bedrooms and 1 kid-friendly bunk room. The first guest bedroom boasts a king bed, and the second includes a king bed plus a built-in twin-over-twin bunk—excellent for families. The bunk room has 4 twin-over-twin beds. For extended stays, there is a washer and dryer on this level.At Seacrest Beach’s Lucky Sevens, fun is always in the cards! Parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes and tram service to the beach and pool—makes it easy for guests to get around! To access the beach, simply use the private access off Seacrest Beach Boulevard—about an 11-minute walk from the home. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 15):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 4 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*This home is pet-friendly, for up to 2 dogs, with an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
